record_type_quote: The claim selected for replication from Study 2 of Nelson et al. (2009) was that participants rate the same movie clip as more enjoyable when it is interrupted with an advertisement (even when the disrupting advertisement is equally enjoyable as the program itself) than when it is not interrupted with an advertisement.

targets.outcome_quote: The replication of the claim was unsuccessful according to the SCORE criteria. Specifically, for stage 1 data collection (analytic N = 380), we found no significant difference between conditions. For stage 2 (with additional participants, analytic N = 1125), we found a significant difference between conditions in the opposite direction.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly call the replication unsuccessful; pooled results significantly reverse the original direction.
